retrieved_documents.title: Account access and permissions
retrieved_documents.text:
# Account access and permissions

Workspace roles are Owner, Admin, Editor and Viewer. Owners manage billing and transfer ownership. Admins invite users from Settings > Members > Invite and select their role. Editors create and edit workflows but cannot manage billing or members. Viewers can inspect workflows and run history but cannot edit. An Admin or Owner can change roles in Settings > Members. Invitations expire after seven days; resend expired invitations from Members.

retrieved_documents.title: Workflow configuration
retrieved_documents.text:
# Workflow configuration

A workflow consists of one trigger followed by actions. Editors and Admins can create workflows from Workflows > New workflow. Add the trigger, map required fields, then add actions. Save as Draft and use Test with sample data. Review test results in Run history before selecting Publish. Pausing a published workflow stops new runs; existing runs may continue. Do not publish a workflow until its test succeeds.

retrieved_documents.title: Subscription and billing policies
retrieved_documents.text:
# Subscription and billing policies

Subscriptions are billed monthly or annually according to the signed order. Owners can download invoices and update payment details in Settings > Billing. Support cannot promise refunds, discounts or credits. Refund, cancellation and contract-change requests go to the billing specialist for review against the customer agreement. Do not quote pricing without the applicable agreement. A failed payment notification should be reviewed by the workspace Owner.

retrieved_documents.title: Salesforce integration troubleshooting
retrieved_documents.text:
# Salesforce integration troubleshooting

Connect Salesforce with a dedicated authorized integration user. Confirm that user can access the target object and required fields. For INVALID_SESSION_ID, reconnect Salesforce from Settings > Integrations and test a single sample record. For field permission errors, ask the Salesforce administrator to verify object and field access. For repeated failures, collect run IDs, error text, last successful run time and scope of impact. Bulk replay, lost data recovery and production outages require engineering review; support must not promise a fix or recommend blind replay.

retrieved_documents.title: Specialist escalation procedure
retrieved_documents.text:
# Specialist escalation procedure

Escalate production outages, possible data loss, security incidents and unresolved integration errors. Assign engineering for production incidents, technical support for integration investigation and billing for contract decisions. Record business impact, affected workflow, time of onset, redacted error and last successful run. A human owner decides mitigation and next update time. Never promise recovery or a service-level deadline without a confirmed agreement. Security reports must avoid transmitting secrets.

The support team can arrange an onboarding session; ask for workspace name, intended use case and two preferred time windows. Do not promise a specific appointment until confirmed.

retrieved_documents.text:
# Workflow configuration

A workflow consists of one trigger followed by actions. Editors and Admins can create workflows from Workflows > New workflow. Add the trigger, map required fields, then add actions. Save as Draft and use Test with sample data. Review test results in Run history before selecting Publish. Pausing a published workflow stops new runs; existing runs may continue. Do not publish a workflow until its test succeeds.

# Sign-in troubleshooting

Use the same email address used for the invitation. For password-based accounts, use Forgot password on the sign-in page and check spam for the reset link. Links expire after 30 minutes. If the account uses company SSO, ask the company identity administrator to check access. Do not request passwords or authentication codes. If access still fails, collect the workspace name, timestamp and exact error text for technical support.
